'''''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide''''' is a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and published by [[Dorling Kindersley|DK Publishing]] on [[August 30]], [[2010]].<ref name="DK" />

==Publisher's summary==
''War still rages in the galaxy! The Republic's Clone Army and Jedi Knights continue to fight the Separatist threat. But new worlds face danger and new enemies are emerging. Things are about to get complicated...''
